scoring_justification: Checker compares agent-reported values in CSV files against paper's reported numbers with per-property tolerances. Raw intermediate artifacts (computed_energies.json) are not required to be submitted, so full recomputation from raw data is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for binding energies and thermodynamic functions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 10.1016/j.cplett.2003.06.002, Table 1 (rows for B3LYP/6-311++G(3df,3pd) and UMP2/6-311++G(3df,3pd)) and Table 2 (Cp, S, H values at T1,T2,T3)
hidden_assets.generation_method: hardcoded from the paper's reported numbers, exactly as used in solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported experimental results, traceable to the specified tables.

outputs.description: Binding energies (D_e and D₀) for HO₂–HClO₄ → HO₂ + HClO₄ at two levels of theory.
Computed thermodynamic functions (Cₚ, S, H⁰−H₂₉₈.₁₅⁰) at 100 K, 298.15 K, and 1000 K.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the agent’s reported values against the paper’s originally reported numbers with per‑property tolerances; no gold values are exposed in this contract.
